description: Rago catalog seed for Menivor (video/reel generation + LLM relay). Bills the real provider spend of media renders and LLM calls as a pass-through metric, so the invoice line equals the metered cost carried on each event.

billable_metrics.name: Menivor Media & LLM Spend
billable_metrics.description: One event per media render or LLM call. `units` sums the billable units consumed (render-seconds or 1k-token blocks); each event also carries `precise_total_amount_cents` = the actual upstream provider spend, which the dynamic charge bills through at cost + margin.

plans.name: Menivor Studio
plans.description: Monthly studio seat plus metered, pass-through media and LLM spend.

sample_events.note: POST /events { event: { transaction_id, external_subscription_id, code: 'menivor_media_spend', properties: { units: 12 }, precise_total_amount_cents: '340' } } — units for the sum aggregation, precise_total_amount_cents for the dynamic pass-through price (in cents).
